parties.respondent: Chief Commissioner of Income Tax & Anr.

summary: Compounding of offence under Section 276CC, Income Tax Act; 'first offence' interpretation; delay in filing return; compounding application rejected due to prior show cause notice; guidelines for compounding, 2014; prosecution for belated filing; whether successive delays constitute first offence; admission of compounding based on timing of notice and filing; legal interpretation of administrative guidelines.
legal_provisions_cited: Guidelines for Compounding of Offences under Direct Tax Laws, 2014
final_judgment: Appeal disposed of with directions; matter remanded for reconsideration of compounding application in light of legal principles governing 'first offence' and procedural fairness.
